title: liquiditybot — problem / solution
description: Every failure mode as a PROBLEM whose panel shows the live detector and names the SOLUTION mechanism handling it.

options.content: **Incident board — a calm board is all green.** Every tile is a PROBLEM paired with the SOLUTION that fires automatically; any non-zero / amber / red tile is a live incident worth a look. Refresh 30s · window 24h.

panels.title: Stale status
panels.description: PROBLEM: runner frozen. SOLUTION: wedge-guard escalates; supervisor revives a dead runner.

panels.title: Kraken WS
panels.description: SOLUTION: on drop the engine falls back to REST — trading continues.

panels.title: Stale marks
panels.description: PROBLEM: old prices. SOLUTION: mark-freshness gate holds non-escape risk; stops still run.

panels.title: Stale assets held
panels.description: Watchdog quarantined assets — entries blocked until feed heals.

panels.title: Entries blocked
panels.description: Feed watchdog blocking new entries (a solution firing).

panels.title: Divergent feeds
panels.description: Cross-venue book divergence count.

panels.title: PROBLEM: model Brier
panels.description: Detector. SOLUTION: the governor kills the model + queues a retrain when Brier crosses baseline.

panels.title: vs baseline
panels.description: The bar Brier must stay under.

panels.title: SOLUTION: governor
panels.description: 0 OK / 1 shrink+throttle / 2 model killed to the prior.

panels.title: SOLUTION: retrain
panels.description: Auto-retrain queued to replace a degrading champion.

panels.title: Drift share
panels.description: PROBLEM: input drift. SOLUTION: retrain re-fits.

panels.title: Kelly throttle
panels.description: Size shrinks as confidence falls.

panels.title: Model fallbacks
panels.description: Inference fell to the prior (fail-safe firing).

panels.title: Infer faults
panels.description: Inference errors.

panels.title: Contract fails
panels.description: Input outside contract.

panels.title: Retrain failures
panels.description: Auto-retrain crashed.

panels.title: Calibration gap
panels.description: Miscalibration; ECE.

panels.title: Dirty rows dropped
panels.description: PROBLEM: legacy/imported non-finite rows. SOLUTION: the ML-015 load backstop drops them before they NaN a fit (0 = corpus clean by construction).

panels.title: Twin rows excluded
panels.description: Synthetic candidate twins of REAL trades excluded so a taken signal is never double-counted (realized label kept). Nonzero is healthy — it tracks taken teach-trades.

panels.title: PROBLEM: drawdown
panels.description: SOLUTION: drawdown throttle + 15% hard-stop flatten.

panels.title: Loss streak
panels.description: PROBLEM: consecutive losers. SOLUTION: per-asset circuit breaker.

panels.title: Breakers tripped
panels.description: Assets currently paused.

panels.title: Heat vs cap
panels.description: SOLUTION: heat throttled under the CVaR cap.

panels.title: Taper mult
panels.description: SOLUTION: loss-budget taper shrinks size.

panels.title: Daily budget used
panels.description: Daily loss budget consumed.

panels.title: Weekly budget used
panels.description: Weekly loss budget consumed.

panels.title: Circuit breaker — paused assets
panels.description: Per-asset breaker state; hours-left counts the cool-off.

panels.title: op-state
panels.description: Central fault authority: ARMED / DEGRADED / HALTED.

panels.title: Latched faults
panels.description: Active latched faults.

panels.title: Firewall fault
panels.description: Risk-firewall latched fault (blocks new risk).

panels.title: Cycle wedge
panels.description: PROBLEM: failing cycles. SOLUTION: runner wedge escalation.

panels.title: Exit-eval failures
panels.description: A position wedging its own exit path.

panels.title: Venue rejects
panels.description: OM-021 AddOrder rejects.

panels.title: Manipulation suspicion by asset
panels.description: PROBLEM: painted/spoofed books. SOLUTION: THALES shades size + down-weights those training rows.
